newsitem.title: USA: Technology partners quit KPMG Peat Marwick LLP.
newsitem.headline: Technology partners quit KPMG Peat Marwick LLP.

text.p: The U.S. management team of the strategic services consulting practice of KPMG Peat Marwick LLP -- the technology and transformation consulting arm of KPMG - U.S. -- said Thursday they resigned from the firm on January 28 to form a new consulting and systems integration business.

The three individuals are Ted Fernandez, national managing partner and member of the U.S. firm's management committee, Ulysses Knotts, national partner in charge of enterprise integration services and national partner in charge of sales and marketing, and Allan Frank, national partner in charge of enabling technologies, the firm's chief technology officer and a member of the U.S. firm's board of directors.
They said the details of their new business will be announced in the future.
